title: Paper Towel Holder Stand (Freestanding) - Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep paper towels right where you need them—on the counter, stable, and ready for fast cleanups. This freestanding paper towel holder keeps the roll upright to save space and stays steady as you tear off sheets.

  • Stays stable while you tear thanks to a weighted base designed to keep the stand steady.
  • No mounting required with a freestanding countertop design—place it where you prep, cook, or clean.
  • Protects your countertop with a felt pad on the base to prevent scratching.
  • Coordinates with matching pieces as part of the Carolina Collection for a matching Carolina look.
  • Built from brass and finished with a designer finish for corrosion-free and rust-free performance.

Specs & Details

  • Collection: Carolina
  • Style: Traditional
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Freestanding
  • Assembly required: No
  • Overall dimensions: 6.5 in L x 6.5 in W x 14.4 in H (projection 6.5 in)
  • Weight capacity: 5 lb
  • Product weight: 4 lb
  • Included: Paper towel holder
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Carolina Collection Counter Top Paper Towel Stand
_previous.description: Elegantly hold your paper towel roll on this classic traditional design paper towel stand. Its design is as functional as it is practical. The roll in the stand sits upright on the counter top allowing for space saving. It has a weight in the base to keep the unit stable as you tear off the sheets.
